name: stuck-loop-diff-judged
description: Three failures of one command with a long output that differs in one line: the judge says stuck, the third result is replaced by a short diff against the second, and the full output is saved.

agentFiles.pi-warden/config.json: {"typesafe": true, "typesafeBackend": {"label": "Fixture judge", "host": "{{server:judge}}", "keyEnv": "FIXTURE_JUDGE_KEY", "defaultModel": "jev-latest"}, "notices": false, "action": {"enabled": false}, "security": {"enabled": false, "maskOutput": false}, "context": {"enabled": false}, "slop": {"enabled": false}, "done": {"enabled": false}, "rules": {"enabled": false}, "runaway": {"enabled": false}, "subagent": {"enabled": false}, "stuck": {"cooldown": 0}}

legend.1: Cosmetic changes: different flags, paths, or wording, same underlying idea
legend.2: Meaningfully different: a new hypothesis, tool, or information-gathering step
